entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-19
entry.content:
Issues

  • SignalR client hanging on reconnections #63333

  • Store "Configure Multiple Startup Projects" settings on the SLN file itself #61250
  • IOutboundParameterTransformer removed in a version that only updated the Minor version 2.2.0 to 2.3.0 but also seems to appear in main branch in same place #60715
